scope: Complete A1/A2/T1/T2 screen on model seed42 and one fixed validation split. Common-four scores are from each run's native-selected checkpoint. Not a promotion or a completed seed-repeat comparison.
limitations: Native four/five/six balanced accuracies average different classes and must not rank target formulations directly.
Native five-class Class VIII means Co+Ni; common-four Class VIII means Fe+Co+Ni.
Common-four probabilities sum Fe/Co/Ni mass before argmax; native confusion matrices cannot simply be merged to reproduce these predictions.
Native balanced accuracy chooses both checkpoint and per-variant LR; the common-four-preferred LR field is diagnostic only and does not change frozen selections.
The target comparison includes native inverse-frequency weighting, native model selection and output-head changes, not output dimensionality alone.
All target formulations use native-six eligible pockets, shared PDB-grouped membership and nominal model seed42. Native-six Co and Ni supports are only13 and7.
Selected seed43 LR can differ across target formulations; such repeat comparisons describe independently selected recipes, not a fixed-LR contrast.
No case-level error claims, confidence intervals, held-out evaluation or candidate promotion.
Direct-four A1/A2 here are legacy original architecture baselines, not geometry arm A.
